'''Clan Deshra''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clan that was active during the [[Galactic War]]. Members of the clan reverse-engineered [[Alien/Legends|alien]] technology to develop their own [[retribution feedback shield]]s almost a [[Standard century/Legends|standard century]] before the conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the resurgent [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] broke out, and [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|sold]] the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] to the highest bidder.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Clan Deshra was first introduced into ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Starfighter]]'' expansion for the [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
